releases.name: CacheBell 0.6.0
releases.body:
On OpenCode 2, cache reminders now default to **open session tabs only**. A bundled TUI component loads automatically and checks your open tabs; switching tabs keeps a reminder, while closing the tab or terminal silences it. With tabs disabled, only the currently viewed session is eligible. Warnings are claimed atomically, so several clients never duplicate one, and notifications play on the terminal client's machine.

To keep the previous server-side behavior for every tracked session, even after closing its tab or client, set `"sessionScope": "all"` in the plugin options. Browser, desktop, and API-only sessions have no TUI, so they need `"all"` to receive reminders. OpenCode 1 is unchanged.

The README and guide now show OpenCode 2's native `plugins` object form alongside OpenCode 1's tuple form.

Upgrade your OpenCode plugin entry to `opencode-cachebell@0.6.0` and restart OpenCode.

releases.name: CacheBell 0.5.0
releases.body:
Four new bundled sounds: **Cat Meow**, **Rooster Crow**, **Horse Neigh**, and **Cow Moo**. Select them with `sound: "cat-meow"`, `"rooster-crow"`, `"horse-neigh"`, or `"cow-moo"`. The two sheep clips are now quieter; Pulse remains the default.

Upgrade your OpenCode plugin entry to `opencode-cachebell@0.5.0` and restart OpenCode.

releases.name: CacheBell 0.4.0
releases.body:
Two new bundled sounds: **Sheep Field** (2.5-second field bleat) and **Sheep Close** (1.36-second close-up bleat). Select them with `sound: "sheep-field"` or `sound: "sheep-close"`; `"sheep"` aliases Sheep Field. Pulse remains the default.

Releases now publish to npm through GitHub Actions trusted publishing with provenance—no local npm login required. All 44 tests pass.

Upgrade your OpenCode plugin entry to `opencode-cachebell@0.4.0` and restart.

releases.name: CacheBell 0.3.0
releases.body:
CacheBell now works with **OpenCode 2** and OpenCode 1 from the same package.

- Version 2 drives the bell through the `model.request` session hook and the subscribed event stream; version 1 keeps using `chat.headers`. The logic that decides when a window opens, when cache reads or writes confirm it, and when the bell is due is shared.
- Titles, summaries and compactions no longer arm a window — nobody is waiting on those.
- Version 2 runs one plugin instance per location against one shared event stream, so a session now rings only in the instance whose directory owns it.
- 41 passing tests.

Upgrade the OpenCode plugin entry to `opencode-cachebell@0.3.0` and restart.

releases.name: CacheBell 0.2.0
releases.body:
Three original sounds are now included: **Pulse** (the new default), **Chime**, and **Knock**.

- Choose with `"sound": "chime"`, `"pulse"`, or `"knock"`. `true` uses Pulse; `false` stays silent.
- The same bundled WAVs play across platforms, including Windows-host playback from WSL.
- Shorter README, with technical details moved to the guide. 29 passing tests.

Upgrade the OpenCode plugin entry to `opencode-cachebell@0.2.0` and restart.

Manual installations must now keep the `sounds/` directory alongside `index.js`.
